title: Promissory estoppel
summary: An assurance that induces justified action or forbearance may be enforced when necessary to avoid injustice.
notes: The materials develop reliance-based enforcement from Ricketts through two versions of § 90, Feinberg, Cohen, D&G Stout, and Drennan. A promise, induced reliance, and the injustice inquiry perform distinct work. D&G Stout does not promise future profits for an indefinite period; Drennan protects a chance to accept an offer. Relief may be limited as justice requires under the second Restatement wording. Case-specific holdings and jurisdictional formulations should remain separate.
